top: Paralympian Ezra Frech's prosthetic leg fell off in the middle of the Dancing with the Stars finale. He kept dancing on one leg.
comment: His partner handed it back, he strapped it on mid-routine… and he became the first Paralympian ever to win the show.
topic_it: Ezra Frech, 21 anni, paralimpico: la protesi si stacca durante il freestyle della finale di Dancing with the Stars (24 nov 2026), continua su una gamba, la rimette e vince la stagione 35
photo_it: Frech che alza la protesi sul palco (NZ Herald)
title: What happened when his leg fell off on national TV #dwts #ezrafrech #history
description:
Paralympian Ezra Frech's prosthetic leg came off during the Dancing with the Stars finale, he put it back on mid-routine, and he won the season.
